stories.headline: Warren Buffett hands the Berkshire chair to his son
stories.summary: Warren Buffett has stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway. His son, Howard Graham Buffett, replaces him. Greg Abel had already succeeded Warren Buffett as chief executive at the beginning of 2026.

stories.headline: Japan's benchmark rate rises to its highest since 1995
stories.summary: The Bank of Japan has raised its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to 1.25 per cent. That is the highest level since 1995. The bank pointed to inflation pressures from rising energy costs and a weak yen, and signalled further increases.

stories.headline: An Aztec codex returns to Mexico City on loan
stories.summary: The 16th-century Codex Azcatitlan has gone on display in Mexico City, after France loaned two folios. The manuscript left the country nearly two centuries ago. It sets out the history of the Mexica and their migration journey from Aztlán.

stories.headline: A record year for the world's heaviest parrot
stories.summary: A record 90 chicks have been added to New Zealand's kakapo population this year. The Department of Conservation shared a tally of 325 birds on 1 September. The kakapo lives only in New Zealand and is the world's heaviest parrot.
